properties.raw_text: Interaction influence of two drugs after simultaneously taking tacrolimus and ertapenem in renal transplant patients... The blood concentration of tacrolimus on 3d after taking was increased from (7.5±0.34) ng/mL to (13.8±0.25) ng/mL (P<0.05). ... In simultaneously using tacrolimus (FK-506) and ertapenem for kidney transplant patients, the tacrolimus dose should be timely adjusted for preventing the drug poisoning.
